instructions:
Add the options and the autocmd most Neovim users end up with.

1. In init.lua add:
     vim.opt.relativenumber = true   -- keep number = true too: you get a hybrid
     vim.opt.scrolloff = 8
     vim.opt.undofile = true
     vim.opt.smartcase = true        -- with ignorecase: case-sensitive once you type a capital
     vim.opt.splitright = true
     vim.opt.splitbelow = true
2. Highlight on yank:
     local grp = vim.api.nvim_create_augroup('my_config', { clear = true })
     vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('TextYankPost', {
       group = grp,
       callback = function() vim.hl.on_yank() end,
     })
3. Optional: spell checking on every file (`set spell`) is noisy in code.
   If you want it, make it prose-only:
     vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('FileType', { group = grp,
       pattern = { 'markdown', 'gitcommit', 'text' },
       callback = function() vim.opt_local.spell = true end })
4. Restart. Run yip and watch the flash. Try 5j using the relative numbers.

Read more: :help 'scrolloff', :help 'smartcase', :help nvim_create_autocmd(), :help vim.hl.on_yank()
